page_title: JUV 2-2 VEN | Juventus v Venezia 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' The referee blows his whistle for unsporting behaviour, with Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) the culprit. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+5' 2 - 2 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Filip Stankovic.
90+5' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

90+4' The players claim that Antonio Candela (Venezia) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Juventus are awarded a penalty.

90+4' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Filip Stankovic thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
90+1' Marin Sverko (Venezia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Giua had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' John Yeboah (Venezia) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

90' Antonio Candela (Venezia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Venezia will have an opportunity.
88' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just wide of the right post.
86' Weston McKennie (Juventus) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
86' Alexandre Hugeux decides to make a substitution. Kenan Yildiz will be replaced by Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus).
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Danilo as he is replaced by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus).

83' 1 - 2 Jay Idzes (Venezia) outjumps the defence in the centre of the box and connects with the free kick from Hans Nicolussi Caviglia. He sends the ball inside the right post with his towering header and alters the score to 1:2.
82' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Antonio Giua signals a set piece. Venezia win a free kick.
81' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
81' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Christian Gytkjaer replaces him.
81' Here is a change. Mikael Egill Ellertsson is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Domen Crnigoj (Venezia).
80' Substitution. Nicolo Savona did his best and is replaced by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus).
80' The game is interrupted now, Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

79' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
75' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
74' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Magnus Kofod Andersen is replaced by Antonio Candela (Venezia).
74' Today's match ends for Joel Pohjanpalo who will be replaced by John Yeboah (Venezia).
73' The corner from Douglas Luiz (Juventus) is intercepted by the defence.

73' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

71' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Filip Stankovic with a brilliant diving save!
71' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:6. 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
67' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
66' Alexandre Hugeux has decided to make a change. Douglas Luiz (Juventus) replaces Teun Koopmeiners.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) comes onto the pitch so that Timothy Weah can be given a rest.

61' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Francesco Zampano and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
59' A wild effort from Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
58' Weston McKennie (Juventus) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
57' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
57' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) commits a foul and Antonio Giua immediately signals a free kick.
55' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) gets inside the box and tries to beat Filip Stankovic with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
55' Great play by Gianluca Busio releases Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) who decides to shoot from distance, but he balloons it high over the bar.
53' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) gets the ball from a rebound before trying his luck with a good long-range shot which threatens the goalkeeper! The ball sails just over the crossbar!
52' Rough tackle by Giorgio Altare (Venezia). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Celebrations are cut short for Juventus as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
51' The Juventus players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Giua makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
49' GOAL! The corner comes over and Khephren Thuram wins a simple header before Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) nods the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
49' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
49' Danilo (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) sends the corner into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts it and averts the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
41' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
40' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
38' Timothy Weah (Juventus) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
37' 3:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:0.
33' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
32' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) will deliver the corner kick.
32' Eusebio Di Francesco is forced to make a change. Michael Svoboda (Venezia) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Giorgio Altare.
32' Michael Svoboda (Venezia) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
31' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Venezia earn a corner.
30' Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) wastes a promising chance as he unleashes a first-time shot from mid-range which hits the crossbar!
26' Michael Svoboda (Venezia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
24' Michael Svoboda (Venezia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
24' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Antonio Giua who sees an offensive foul.
23' Timothy Weah (Juventus) is caught offside yet again.
22' The resulting corner from Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) is cleared.

21' A pass lands at the feet of Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Venezia.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Federico Gatti (Juventus) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Khephren Thuram knock down. 1:0.
19' The ball goes out of play and Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Danilo (Juventus) attempts to find Teun Koopmeiners, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
12' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the shot whistles inches wide of the left post.

11' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Antonio Giua stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Juventus win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
10' Timothy Weah (Juventus) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
8' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
3' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Juventus will take a throw-in.
2' Juventus are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' Half-chance! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) plays a pass into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio reacts well to snuff out the attack.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Venezia will have the kick-off.
Antonio Giua is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
